name: app.vaultan/vaultan
title: Vaultan
description: Free in-browser PDF and photo tools on vaultan.app, its pages as Markdown, and app facts.

tools.name: suggest_browser_tool
tools.description: Given a job to do on a PDF, photo or other file (for example "combine three PDFs", "remove the location from a photo", "HEIC to JPG"), returns the vaultan.app browser tool that does it, with its address and what it does. The tools run in the web browser on the person's own device: the file is not uploaded and no account is needed. For a conversion it also says whether that pair of formats is supported.

task.description: The job in plain words, for example "make a PDF smaller" or "png to pdf".

tools.name: list_browser_tools
tools.description: Lists every file tool on vaultan.app with what it does and its address: merge, split, compress, sign, redact, rotate and number PDFs, images to PDF, PDF to JPG, remove photo location, blur part of a photo, and a file converter. They run in the web browser on the person's own device: files are not uploaded and no account is needed.

tools.name: about_vaultan
tools.description: What the Vaultan app is, who publishes it, the platforms it is on, where to download it, its price, and where its security design and privacy policy are published.

tools.name: find_pages
tools.description: Searches the titles and descriptions of the English pages of vaultan.app (features, browser tools, comparisons, guides, research, security) and returns the best matches with their addresses.

query.description: Words to look for, for example "redact pdf" or "photo location".

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Returns the text of one page of vaultan.app as Markdown. Give the path from find_pages, for example "/security/" or "/de/tools/merge-pdf/".

path.description: The page path, starting and ending with "/".
